description: Mansfield-style relative strength (RS) computed across 32+ coin universe. RS = (coin_price / base_price) normalized to 100 at t=0. Returns RS-now, RS-7d-ago, RS-30d-ago, cross-sectional rank, rank-delta trends, and strengthening/weakening/neutral trend classification vs. a configurable base (default BTC). Informational research data — not investment advice.
